not_reuse_examples: [5,7,9] Optuna/DEHB/Hyperopt: mentioned only as 'public implementations' of better tuners; not executed.
[24,45,46,57,58] 'Cited By' column entries: papers that used MOOT data (downstream users), not sources this paper reuses; [58] kept only as a low-confidence sanitycheck footnote.
Pygmo/Platypus/SPLOT and ZDT/DTLZ benchmarks: contrasted with MOOT as alternatives, not used.
[70] Yu et al. vulnerability active learning and [16] personal communication: motivational background only.
[3,4,23,68,69] 'optimization dramatically transforms results' and [17,41,35,6,8,22,26] : background claims with no number/theorem/method adopted.
[47] MOOT itself and MOOT0 scripts are the authors' own artifacts; MOOT0 kept as one software edge (executed) since Sec 3 runs it.
notes: Repository paper: 34 dataset edges (15 self-authored) all executed by the naive BASELINE on 127 datasets; six v1 sanitychecks re-typed numericfact ([61],[2],[63],[32],[71],[58]); no replication/theory/refuting edges exist (Fig.1 is reproduced from [61], not regenerated; 'contrary to current fashion' names no target).
